paragraphs: The HSE runs Ireland's public health service. On Monday, its board removed the head of the HSE, Anne O'Connor. She had to leave her job at once.
Her deputy, Damien McCallion, will do the job for now. Later, the HSE will choose a new chief.
Today the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, will talk about the decision in the Dáil. Opposition parties want answers. They ask who knew about the plan and when.
Health Minister Jennifer Carroll MacNeill says the board made the decision. She says she supports the board.

The HSE has spent too much money this year. The Government gave it an extra €780 million last week. Doctors and nurses are worried about the busy winter. Anne O'Connor says she will fight the decision.
sentZh: HSE負責營運愛爾蘭的公共衛生服務。
週一，HSE董事會撤換了HSE的負責人安妮・歐康納。
她必須立即離職。
她的副手達米恩・麥卡利恩將暫時接手這份工作。
之後，HSE將選出新的首長。
今天，總理米歇爾・馬丁將在眾議院談論這項決定。
反對黨想要答案。
他們問誰知道這項計畫，又是何時知道的。
衛生部長珍妮佛・卡羅爾・麥克尼爾說，這項決定是董事會做的。
她說她支持董事會。
HSE今年花了太多錢。
政府上週額外撥給它7億8000萬歐元。
醫生和護理師擔心忙碌的冬天。
安妮・歐康納說她會對抗這項決定。

paragraphs: The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, is expected to speak in the Dáil today about the sudden removal of the head of the Health Service Executive (HSE). The HSE is the organisation that runs public health services in Ireland.

On Monday, the HSE board said that Anne O'Connor would leave her job as chief executive immediately. The board said it used a process in her contract and believed the change was best for the organisation's future. Her deputy, Damien McCallion, will lead the HSE until a new chief executive is chosen.

Health Minister Jennifer Carroll MacNeill says the decision was only for the board to make. However, she said she supports it. She also said she had known since September that the board was thinking about removing Ms O'Connor, and she was told the final decision on Saturday.

Opposition parties want more information. Sinn Féin asked what part the minister played. The Green Party wants a special debate in the Dáil, and Independent Ireland wants to know who knew what and when.

Ms O'Connor's short time in the job was difficult. In August, the head of Cork University Hospital warned in a letter that the hospital was 1,000 staff short and would not be safe this winter. Last week, the Cabinet also agreed to give the HSE an extra €780 million because it had spent more than its budget.
Hospital consultants have asked the HSE board to resign, and nursing unions are worried about the winter. Ms O'Connor says she will fight her removal as strongly as she can.

HSE是負責營運愛爾蘭公共衛生服務的機構。
週一，HSE董事會表示，安妮・歐康納將立即卸下執行長一職。
董事會說，它依照她合約中的一套程序行事，並認為這項改變對機構的未來最好。
她的副手達米恩・麥卡利恩將領導HSE，直到選出新的執行長為止。
衛生部長珍妮佛・卡羅爾・麥克尼爾說，這項決定只能由董事會做出。
不過，她表示自己支持這項決定。
她也說，她從九月起就知道董事會正在考慮撤換歐康納女士，並在週六得知最終決定。
反對黨想要更多資訊。
新芬黨質問部長扮演了什麼角色。
綠黨希望在眾議院舉行特別辯論，而獨立愛爾蘭黨則想知道誰在何時知道了什麼。
歐康納女士短暫的任期並不順利。
八月時，科克大學醫院的院長在一封信中警告，該院缺少1,000名員工，今年冬天將不安全。
上週，內閣也同意額外撥給HSE 7億8000萬歐元，因為它的支出超出了預算。
醫院專科醫師要求HSE董事會辭職，護理工會也擔心今年冬天的情況。
歐康納女士說她會盡全力對抗自己遭撤換一事。

paragraphs: Taoiseach Micheál Martin is expected to address the Dáil today on the abrupt removal of Anne O'Connor as chief executive of the Health Service Executive (HSE), as opposition parties demand clarity over who was involved in the decision.

The HSE board announced on Monday that Ms O'Connor's tenure would end with immediate effect. It said the move followed a process set out in her contract and was in the best interests of the organisation's future operation. Deputy chief executive Damien McCallion has agreed to serve as interim head until a permanent appointment is made.

Minister for Health Jennifer Carroll MacNeill has insisted that the decision was exclusively a matter for the board, although she has given it her backing. She said she had been aware since September of a process that could lead to Ms O'Connor's removal, and that the final decision was communicated to her on Saturday.

Sinn Féin's health spokesperson, David Cullinane, has asked what influence the minister had, while the Green Party is seeking a special Dáil debate. Independent Ireland, which raised questions about Ms O'Connor's performance last week, wants the Coalition to explain who knew what and when.

Ms O'Connor's brief time in charge was marked by controversy. In August, a leaked letter from the head of Cork University Hospital warned that a shortage of 1,000 staff meant the hospital would not be safe going into winter. Last week, the Cabinet approved a supplementary budget of €780 million for the HSE amid concern over repeated overspending.

The Irish Hospital Consultants Association has called on the HSE board to resign, and nursing unions have voiced concern ahead of the winter. Ms O'Connor has said she will challenge her removal as vigorously as possible.

HSE董事會週一宣布，歐康納女士的任期即刻結束。
董事會表示，此舉依循她合約中所訂的程序，且符合該機構未來營運的最佳利益。
副執行長達米恩・麥卡利恩已同意擔任臨時首長，直到正式任命新人為止。
衛生部長珍妮佛・卡羅爾・麥克尼爾堅稱，這項決定完全是董事會的事，不過她已表態支持。
她說，她自九月起就知道有一項可能導致歐康納女士被撤換的程序，而最終決定是在週六告知她的。
新芬黨衛生事務發言人大衛・庫利南質問部長究竟有多大影響力，綠黨則要求舉行眾議院特別辯論。
上週曾質疑歐康納女士工作表現的獨立愛爾蘭黨，要求聯合政府說明誰在何時知道了什麼。
歐康納女士短暫的任期爭議不斷。
八月時，科克大學醫院院長一封外洩的信件警告，人力短缺1,000人意味著該院進入冬季後將不安全。
上週，在外界對HSE一再超支的憂慮聲中，內閣批准了一筆7億8000萬歐元的追加預算。
愛爾蘭醫院專科醫師協會已呼籲HSE董事會辭職，護理工會也在入冬前表達憂慮。
歐康納女士表示，她將盡全力挑戰對她的撤職決定。

paragraphs: Micheál Martin is poised to address the Dáil today on the abrupt ousting of Anne O'Connor as chief executive of the Health Service Executive (HSE), amid mounting opposition demands for transparency over who had a hand in the decision.

In a terse statement on Monday, the HSE board confirmed that Ms O'Connor's tenure would be terminated with immediate effect, citing a process under the terms of her contract that it deemed to be in the organisation's best interests. Her deputy, Damien McCallion, has stepped in as interim chief executive pending a permanent appointment.

Minister for Health Jennifer Carroll MacNeill has maintained that the matter rested solely with the board, while nonetheless endorsing its decision. She acknowledged that she had been apprised in September of a process that might culminate in Ms O'Connor's dismissal, and that she was notified of the final outcome on Saturday.

The opposition has seized on the affair. Sinn Féin's David Cullinane has questioned the extent of ministerial influence, the Green Party is pressing for a dedicated Dáil debate, and Independent Ireland, which had queried Ms O'Connor's performance only last week, is demanding to know who knew what, and when.

Ms O'Connor's short-lived tenure was beset by controversy. In August, a leaked letter from the chief executive of Cork University Hospital warned that a shortfall of 1,000 staff would leave the hospital unsafe heading into winter. Only last week, the Cabinet sanctioned a €780 million supplementary budget for the HSE, against a backdrop of persistent overspending.

The Irish Hospital Consultants Association has urged the entire board to step down, while nursing unions have voiced disquiet on the eve of the winter crisis. For her part, Ms O'Connor has vowed to contest her removal as vigorously as possible.

她的副手達米恩・麥卡利恩已接任臨時執行長，等待正式任命人選。

她承認自己九月時就已獲悉一項可能以歐康納女士遭解職告終的程序，並於週六接獲最終結果的通知。
反對黨緊抓這起風波不放。
新芬黨的大衛・庫利南質疑部長的影響力究竟有多大，綠黨力促舉行專門的眾議院辯論，而上週才質疑過歐康納女士表現的獨立愛爾蘭黨，則要求知道誰在何時知道了什麼。

paragraphs: The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, is scheduled to address the Dáil today regarding the abrupt removal of Anne O'Connor as chief executive of the Health Service Executive (HSE), a development that has prompted considerable demands for accountability from opposition parties.

According to the HSE board, Ms O'Connor's tenure was concluded with immediate effect following a process provided for in her contract, which the board considered to be in the best interests of the organisation. Consequently, the deputy chief executive, Damien McCallion, will assume the role on an interim basis until a permanent successor is appointed.

The Minister for Health, Jennifer Carroll MacNeill, has emphasised that the decision fell exclusively within the remit of the board; nevertheless, she has expressed her support for it. She has also conceded that she was informed in September of a procedure that could potentially result in Ms O'Connor's removal.

Opposition parties have raised substantial concerns regarding transparency. It is worth noting that Ms O'Connor's tenure was characterised by considerable controversy. In August, a leaked letter from the head of Cork University Hospital indicated that a deficit of 1,000 staff would render the hospital unsafe during the winter months. Furthermore, the Cabinet recently approved a supplementary allocation of €780 million for the HSE, owing to recurrent overspending.

The Irish Hospital Consultants Association has called for the resignation of the board, while nursing unions have expressed apprehension about the forthcoming winter. Ms O'Connor, for her part, intends to challenge the decision as vigorously as possible.
